limitations: Margins are local engineering choices, not academic requirements
Previous smoke outputs informed design; new draws start beyond their observed used-stream ranges
Student coverage is approximate for nonnormal replica statistics; 672 replicas do not prove normality
Finite CDF grid does not establish equality at every quantile or in extreme tails
No acceptance of empirical passenger demand or real travel times
Any failure or inconclusive cell blocks full acceptance; margins and sample size are not relaxed after seeing results
Precision planning uses estimated dispersion, not a guarantee of final half-width or equivalence; no further automatic extension
Lehmer finite-period blocks are disjoint but not a proof of statistical independence
Four million prefix reserved for functional checks; historical MRG data excluded
